actualOfflineProbe.meaning: Validator is intentionally sufficient for minimized read projection, not a standalone erasure authorization/accounting validator. Pure synthetic mismatch accepted; not an actual service bug or incident.

requiredFences: No HTTP dispatch, SDK writes, returned mutation success, retained plan, new marker, flags or implicit idempotency. Missing/expired/already-erased is not PREPARED and not proof of previous successful erasure.

Use validated request-context owner and current active binding, complete verified key inventory; derive owned partition from server-selected proof, cryptographically verify check/payload token and exact PK/SK/checkId. Expected result ID alone is not authority.

Join actual SETTLED receiptId,chargedChecks,processingOutcome,assessmentEpoch and resultSummary to validated governedHistory projection; preserve original deadline and state. Reject mixed, corrupt, foreign or unresolved rows.

Every used read must be acknowledged, strongly consistent and finitely classified. Construct atomic snapshot conditions for inventory/profile/deletion absence/current device pointer+binding/existing canonical receipt, no subscription eligibility requirement.
Remove only governedHistory,governedHistoryDigest,GSI2PK,GSI2SK,resultSummary. Preserve accounting/proofs/dedup/state/operations/GSI1/TTL and all unrelated fields, no upsert.
Full canonical captured-map equality, plus existence/state/deadline conditions, must prevent removal based on a replaced or recreated row. No split profile/device/receipt writes.
Raw transaction material is private and inherently identifying: opaque in-memory object, safe repr, finite public summary only, never call raw condition dictionaries redacted.

Preparation is not fresh execution permission; future dispatch needs current revalidation and unknown-commit/idempotency design. Existing consumers retain generic SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE rather than invented erased semantics.

Source-only tests must prove no writes at preparation, exact synthetic future action field preservation, stale-index canonical suppression, late-settlement/reconciliation no resurrection and read/device/deletion/inventory/row drift fail-closed.
Keep adapter local or verify imports: governed_history package absent from other shared-authority archives.

fullClearStillRequires: P1 exact markers and all-copy/restore lifecycle
